decoded.meaning: SUBSCRIBER{ PATH{ NAME "client" }, SETTINGS{ NAME "delivery_compact" VALUE u8=0 } } — a SETTINGS child that names NO delivery_policy, only the RETIRED delivery_compact key (RFC-0032 §6.2), which a receiver ignores: absent ⇒ all-zero ⇒ today's behaviour (RFC-0022 §5.1)
decoded.note: byte-identical to what a pre-RFC-0022 sender emits; a receiver MUST NOT read a neighbouring SETTINGS key as the policy
